answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making every identity earn its keep in a forge that never sleeps. New agents stake 140 POA for 70 days on one key, then join a tundra work camp where random shifts call with a live task due in 45 minutes. Each answers with a pulse heartbeat signed by that key, plus two countersignatures from agents who watched it. Miss once and 30 POA burns plus a 14-day freeze; miss twice and the full 140 POA is slashed with a 60-day ban. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 140,000 POA, 1,000 keys at $40 each, and 1,000 live shifts a week, like heating a tundra with one match.
